note: Numbers come from Jersey Mike's nutrition calculator API (https://subs.jerseymikes.com/nutrition/data and https://subs.jerseymikes.com/nutrition/{productId}/{sizeId}), which lists each ingredient's nutrition per product and size. Component units are the published regular-sub portion ('each'); build counts are the published portion on that item divided by the component portion (e.g. the #13 uses half the ham of a #3). Item macros are the sum of the item's default ingredients as the calculator reports them. Bowl = Sub in a Tub.

ham.note: meat portion on a regular #3 Ham and Provolone

prosciuttini.note: portion on a regular #5 Super Sub

hard salami.note: portion on a regular #11 Stickball Special

turkey.note: meat portion on a regular #7 Turkey and Provolone

roast beef.note: meat portion on a regular #6 Roast Beef and Provolone

bacon.note: bacon portion on a regular #8 Club Sub

pastrami.note: portion on a regular #20 Grilled Pastrami Reuben

grilled steak.note: Philly beef portion on a regular #17 Mike's Famous Philly

grilled chicken.note: Philly chicken portion on a regular #16 Mike's Chicken Philly

provolone.note: cheese portion on a regular cold sub

swiss.note: cheese portion on a regular #9 Club Supreme

white american cheese.note: cheese portion on a regular cheese steak

grilled portabella mushroom.note: add-on portion for a regular sub

avocado.note: portion on a regular California Club

olive oil blend.note: regular sub portion (part of Mike's Way)

red wine vinegar.note: regular sub portion (part of Mike's Way)

oregano.note: regular sub portion (part of Mike's Way)

salt.note: regular sub portion (part of Mike's Way)

hot honey.note: add-on portion for a regular sub

mike's way.note: regular sub portion; use instead of listing the seven parts separately
mike's way.derived: sum of the published regular-sub portions of lettuce, tomatoes, onions, oregano, salt, olive oil blend, red wine vinegar
